preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of ones k must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > n * n else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than the total number of elements in the matrix, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i][j] == stdout[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: The resulting matrix must be symmetrical with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: sum(stdout[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) == k
postconditions.description: The resulting matrix must contain exactly k ones.
